title: Satwik-Chirag Exit French Open; Asmita, Tanvi Advance
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, faced an early exit, while young talents Asmita Chaliha and Tanvi Sharma showed promise by advancing.
summary: India's world No. 5 men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were knocked out of the French Open by Christo Popov and Toma Junior Popov, losing 19-21, 21-18, 13-21. Meanwhile, Asmita Chaliha and Tanvi Sharma successfully advanced in their respective categories.

title: Praveen Kumar Secures Gold, Banti Silver in Asian Para Games High Jump
indian_angle: India achieved a remarkable 1-2 finish in the high jump T64 event at the Asian Para Games, with Praveen Kumar winning gold and Banti clinching silver.
summary: Praveen Kumar won India's 11th gold medal at the Asian Para Games in the high jump T64 event, closely followed by Banti who secured the silver medal, marking a dominant performance for India.

title: Ayush Verma Claims Second Gold at Asian Para Games in Shot Put
indian_angle: Ayush Verma added another gold medal to India's tally at the Asian Para Games, his second of the edition, highlighting India's strong performance in para-athletics.
summary: Ayush Verma secured his second gold medal at the Asian Para Games, triumphing in the shot put F53 event, contributing to India's growing medal count, which now includes 10 gold medals.

title: India's Para Athletes Shine with 14 Medals, Nishad Wins Two Golds
indian_angle: Indian para-athletes had a stellar second day at the Asian Para Games, adding 14 medals to their tally, with Nishad Kumar becoming the third Indian to win two golds.
summary: On the second day of the Asian Para Games, India's para athletics contingent secured an impressive 14 medals, including five gold, four silver, and five bronze, bringing their total to 20. Nishad Kumar notably clinched his second gold medal of the Games.

title: Harmanpreet Kaur Leads India to Series Sweep in T20 Cricket
indian_angle: Captain Harmanpreet Kaur's return to form powered the Indian women's cricket team to a dominant series sweep, showcasing strong team performance.
summary: Harmanpreet Kaur rediscovered her form, playing a pivotal role as the Indian women's cricket team swept the series, demonstrating a strong performance against their opponents.
